Name: Ahimelech the Hittite
Summary: Ahimelech the Hittite was with David in the wilderness when David crept into Saul's camp at night. David asked him who would go down with him, and Ahimelech is named beside Abishai in that daring night raid.
KeyStory: Ahimelech the Hittite stood with David on the night David stole Saul's spear and cruse.
LifeLesson: Loyalty is proved on night raids, not in daylight speeches.
